divergence_diagnosis.implication: the original compares two operands already live on the FP stack (canvas.y was pushed before the compare), so MSVC emits FCOM ST(1) with the 0x41 flag test (ZF|CF). My form lets MSVC compare against the memory operand directly, which pops and needs the 0x44 test (ZF|PF). The fix is to make canvasSize.y a value that is loaded onto the FP stack before the comparison - i.e. a named float local assigned before the multiply, or the comparison written with the multiply on the left.
divergence_diagnosis.second_difference: after the branch the original does fstp st(0) then fld size.x then fld 0.01 then FMULP; mine does fld size.x then fmul st(1) directly. That is the same liveness issue one level down - the original keeps more values on the FP stack across the compare, so the multiply order follows.
